tagline: The Chemistry Toolkit for STEM Students
brief: A set of interactive tools for incoming STEM and chemistry students that feels fun, empowering, and helpful.

concepts.name: Monogram Catalyst (Ck)
concepts.idea: Interlocking lowercase Ck letterforms where the k branches into an energetic molecular bond node.
rationale: Instant recognition as a developer-grade STEM tool rather than a generic clip-art beaker.
The c forms a smiling meniscus bowl while the k ascender acts as a test tube with a 45° catalytic bond node.
Engineered for sub-16px resilience on favicons, stickers, and mobile app home screens.

recommendation: Concept B (Monogram Catalyst) establishes ChemKit as a premier, modern scientific utility with an iconic Ck monogram that students will proudly stick on laptops and notebooks.
